rows.grounds: fused form of mayā + uktena + eva; analyzed as one token

items.question: By which path should the Kula rite be performed by the practitioner?
items.inference: The Kula rite must be performed along the path taught by the speaker.
uncertainties: Fused token mayoktenaiva combines mayā, uktena, and eva without splitting
items.plain_english: By the path spoken by me, one should perform the Kula rite.
